description: Hochwasser Bayern Juni 2024 is a dataset listed in Data Atlas of Civil Society, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Greenpeace e.V.. After the flood in Bavaria, a team of Greenpeace activists in the affected Allershausen took sediment samples from two playgrounds. The aim was to determine a possible exposure of the playground sand to pollutants that may have been washed up with the flooding. Coverage: Greenpeace e.V.. The portal shows the English title as "Flood Bavaria June 2024" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Greenpeace e.V.. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, PDF. The listing shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/20210721#cc-by-nc/4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datenatlas-zg.
